Priyom,

Notes for the AltTech thread — keep commercial simple and give them an easy win that preserves margin:
- Offer a structured ramp: Month 1-3 pilot credits (as you proposed), Months 4-6 12% committed discount, Month 7+ 18% committed (with 9M token floor). This staggers concessions but gets them to commit.
- For the price-match ask: call out guaranteed lower unit cost on the hosted plan vs SignalDat for equivalent throughput + prefix K/V cache expected savings. Use conservative caching assumptions (15% effective token reduction).
- If they insist on a price parity clause, limit to 60-day renegotiation window and exclude marketplace / cloud-reseller deals.
- Migration assistance: offer one engineer-week of migration support + a runbook. That can be a non-monetary sweetener in lieu of deeper discount.
- On Private/VPC: only offer for 24-month commitments or with a one-time integration fee.

I'll let Laura scope any legal asks. We should avoid an open-ended SLA credit — keep it cap-based.
